title: Finite scalar and ringed pullback coordinates
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l and f:X→Y, with n≥0. Use the integral ringed and finite constant-ring categories and adjunctions of [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge], [def-sf-integral-system-operations] and the coefficient comparisons of [def-sp-coefficient-mate-comparisons], [def-pur-finite-compact-support-scalar-data]. Define finiteRingPullbackIso by uniqueness of derived left adjoints after transporting the ringed geometric adjunction along the derived finiteDirectImage_eq identification to the intrinsic finite geometric adjunction. This pins its unit and counit compatibility directly. Define finiteScalarPullback from ringedPull(f) followed by scalar reduction at X to scalar reduction at Y followed by finiteDerivedPullback(f): first use finiteReductionIso(X,n) inverse, then scalarPull for reduction modulo n+1, then finiteRingPullbackIso(f,n), then finiteReductionIso(Y,n). All factors are actual specified isomorphisms, with no choice of an unproved existence witness.
